_readme: People on the contributor wall (contributors.html, and the first four on the home page). Code contributors come from GitHub on their own, add them here only to give them roles, a different name, or the maintainer mark. Everyone else (testing, design, translations) goes here by hand. Fields: name, github (login, gives the avatar and link) or url, roles, maintainer (true only for the official maintainers, the original team: they come first and get the glow). Roles: code, testing, design, docs, translation, framework.
